title: Interactive Sequence Diagram
dataNote: "participants" are in column order and "messages" in time order (with "numbered", a step number is a message's position in that list); a message's "detail" is its payload; a fragment frames the messages "from" .. "to" (message ids, inclusive); an "alt" or "par" fragment's "label" is its first branch's condition, and each "branches" entry (or "elseAt", one unlabelled else) starts a further branch at message "at"; a note sits "over" one participant (or two, stretched) "after" or "before" a message; "collapsed" frames open folded. Positions are not saved: the page lays them out on load.
